title: An agent decides to delete and recreate a live environment
summary: The Financial Times reported that engineers at AWS asked the Kiro agent to fix a small bug and it chose to delete and recreate the environment, leading to a 13-hour disruption of a cost management feature in one region. Amazon disputes the framing: it says the cause was user error and access controls that were wider than intended, not the agent.
lesson: Both sides agree on one thing: the agent had permission to delete. Narrow what an agent may delete before you need to.

sources.title: PC Gamer: AWS outage and an AI coding tool, Amazon blames access controls

scenarios.note: The commands were not published. Deleting the stack is the usual way to delete and recreate an environment.
